analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 37.6 to 40.1 but remains in neutral territory. MACD histogram improved from -0.0015 to -0.0008, yet no golden cross or bullish expansion signal confirmed. Volume ratio of 0.62 against the 5-day average indicates subdued activity, lowering confidence in current moves. ADX at 25.3 suggests a trend is forming, but with +DI at 17.9 and -DI at 29.2, downward pressure is dominant. The 52-week position at 9.3% remains low.
